request.style: English, male baritone voice, warm and steady, acoustic guitar, fiddle, piano, bass, upright bass, hopeful and earnest mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We have confidence to enter now
By the blood of Jesus it allows
The new and living way is clear
Opened through the curtain
Through his flesh the path is true
We walk upon the ground so new
A great priest stands over the house
We find our rest in his grace

[Chorus]
Draw near with a true heart today
In the full assurance of faith
Our hearts are sprinkled clean
From the evil conscience pain
Bodies washed with pure water
We stand before the Father

[Verse]
Hold unwaveringly to the hope
He who promised is faithful
Let us spur one another on
Toward love and good works
Not neglecting to meet together
As some have made a habit
Encouraging one another more
As we see the Day drawing near

[Chorus]
Draw near with a true heart today
In the full assurance of faith
Our hearts are sprinkled clean
From the evil conscience pain
Bodies washed with pure water
We stand before the Father

[Bridge]
If we deliberately go on sinning
After receiving the knowledge
No sacrifice for sins is left
We must guard our hearts so well

[Chorus]
Draw near with a true heart today
In the full assurance of faith
Our hearts are sprinkled clean
From the evil conscience pain
Bodies washed with pure water
We stand before the Father

[Outro]
He who promised is faithful
We draw near with a true heart
